# Debrief: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus

These clips show how OpenTelemetry and Prometheus fit together: OTLP ingestion and native histograms in Prometheus, the Collector's Prometheus receiver, span-derived metrics, and a real migration to OTel. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s); [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s); [Jaeger V2: The Maintainers' Guide To OpenTelemetry-Native Tracing · 13:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gH_JzIXFshI&t=782s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Prometheus native histograms are stable; since 3.9 you must enable them per scrape config, and exporters and PromQL still have gaps. Prometheus's OTLP receive endpoint also gained new features. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s))
2. One team's OTel Collector pipeline used the Prometheus receiver to scrape existing metrics endpoints, transformed resource attributes, and exported via OTLP and S3. Their Grafana queries needed only small changes, such as underscores to periods. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s); [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 26:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=1563s))
3. Jaeger can derive latency, error and request-rate metrics from spans and send them to Prometheus via remote write, scraping or OTLP. Prometheus is the only supported metrics backend for this. ([Jaeger V2: The Maintainers' Guide To OpenTelemetry-Native Tracing · 13:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gH_JzIXFshI&t=782s))

## Action items

- [ ] Check whether your Prometheus version needs native histograms enabled at scrape level, and list which exporters you run that do not yet expose them. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s))
- [ ] Prototype a Collector pipeline using the Prometheus receiver, a processor adjusting resource attributes, and an OTLP exporter, and compare dashboard queries for naming differences. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s); [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 26:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=1563s))
- [ ] Set up the collector's own internal metrics alerts to catch excessive data volume, and review memory limit settings. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 26:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=1563s))

## Watch together (9 min)

1. [Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s) (1:23), Jan Fajerski, Bartłomiej Płotka: Native histograms and OTLP receive changes directly affect Prometheus users.
2. [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s) (1:22), Yash Sharma, Kunju Perath: Concrete Prometheus receiver to OTLP exporter pipeline from a real migration.
3. [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 26:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=1563s) (1:38), Yash Sharma, Kunju Perath: Covers dashboard query changes and controlling data overload in OTel.
4. [Jaeger V2: The Maintainers' Guide To OpenTelemetry-Native Tracing · 13:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gH_JzIXFshI&t=782s) (3:44), Pavol Loffay: Shows span-derived metrics flowing into Prometheus via several paths.
5. [Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 30:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=1836s) (1:21), Jan Fajerski, Bartłomiej Płotka: Describes Prometheus and OTel schema and telemetry-policy collaboration status.
